name: Switching language preserves the current path
description: Clicking a different locale in the switcher must navigate to the equivalent URL in that locale, preserving the current path (from /en/match/X clicking Portuguese lands on /pt/match/X, not the /pt homepage). A switcher that always dumps the user back to the localized root fails this test.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Open the locale switcher and select Portuguese (pt)

Verify the resulting URL is the Portuguese equivalent of the same match page (path still resolves to match/<captured-id> under the /pt prefix), not the localized homepage. If switching language discards the match path and redirects to /pt root, the test fails.
